description: Pause a signal and return it. A paused signal is not checked and spends nothing; its events stay available in get_signal_events, and it does not count toward the active signal limit. Pausing an already paused signal changes nothing and succeeds. Resume it with resume_signal. Fails with signalNotFound for an unknown id and with signalStopped for a stopped signal.

signalId.description: Signal id, as returned by create_signal or get_signals.

name: pause_signal
